tasks.description:

tasks.subject: Task 2: Register libs/maia-ui-workspace as a Gradle module with generation tasks
tasks.description:
**Goal:** maia-ui-workspace becomes a registered Gradle project with three JavaExec tasks generating TS for elasticsearch/props/job specs into each project's own src/generated.

**Files:**
- Modify: settings.gradle.kts
- Create: libs/maia-ui-workspace/build.gradle.kts

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- settings.gradle.kts includes libs:maia-ui-workspace
- three maiagen* configurations, each scoped to its own spec
- three JavaExec tasks with correct args and outputs.dir
- aggregate maiaGeneration task
- running it produces real non-empty output matching spec field lists for all three
- no unnecessary plugins

**Verify:** ./gradlew :libs:maia-ui-workspace:maiaGeneration (from /home/kevin/dev/code/maia) -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, files verified on disk. NO GIT COMMIT.
